purpose: On the unchanged 16 licensed HOLDOUT rows, split the accumulated MLP-written state that supplies the L11H3 current subject value into three balanced depth groups while measuring exact task behavior and all group interactions.

novelty_audit.relation: This splits downstream compensating MLP13--17 effects after H11.3, not the upstream MLP0--10 writes read by the head.
This subdivides downstream MLP13--17 and is not an upstream current-value decomposition.
This supplies reusable exact residual-recurrence bookkeeping for another task and MLP10 reader; it contains no Task14 MLP0--10 causal interchange.
The canonical dossier contains no executed layerwise split of the upstream MLP-written family.

data.row_builder: unchanged parent v2 fresh matched-natural rows

exact_computation.propagation: At every block entry, multiply every earlier MLP slot by that block's residual lambda0; at MLP i, add its native write to slot i. At the pre-attention-11 capture this equals w_i times the product of lambda0 from blocks i+1 through 11.
exact_computation.grouping_remainder: Form G0, G1, G2 in fixed float32 order and rho_M = captured_M - ((G0+G1)+G2). rho_M belongs to G0, follows the G0 donor, and is added after the three groups.
exact_computation.fixed_state: Recipient E, A, parent state remainder R, attention probability p_8, cached-value branch, and every non-subject L11H3 source term remain fixed.
exact_computation.endpoint: RMS-normalize the recombined pre-L11 subject state, compute only current V11H3, add the fixed cached value in head-value coordinates, apply the native output projection once, install the exact subject head term, and run the native suffix.
exact_computation.invalid_policy: Recipient or all-donor M-group closure above 0.00005, or failure of any inherited replay/source/no-op/install gate, makes the instrument invalid and all scientific arms non-evidence.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_live: All exactness gates pass and all-donor MLP groups help margin and CE in every target cell.
predictions.pred_b_G0_carries_task: G0 alone recovers at least 70% of both all-M margin and CE with at least 75% helpful rows in every cell.
predictions.pred_c_G1_carries_task: G1 alone meets the same frozen task bars.
predictions.pred_d_G2_carries_task: G2 alone meets the same frozen task bars.
predictions.pred_e_distributed_across_depth_groups: No group reaches 70%, while at least two groups each reach 25% of margin and CE and are helpful in every cell.
predictions.pred_f_interaction_is_needed: No singleton reaches 50%, but the total non-additive factorial term reaches 50% of both margin and CE with helpful row signs in every cell.
predictions.pred_g_number_specific: Every same-number lexical group effect is at most 25% of the all-M number effect for margin and CE.
predictions.pred_h_lexical_collateral: At least one lexical effect reaches 50% of the number effect.

routing: Recurse only into a passing group. If no singleton passes but distribution or interaction passes, keep the causally grouped combination as the next object rather than ranking individual layers post hoc.
